_comment: MCP server catalogue for India AI Ad Creator. See AGENTS.md > 'MCP usage' for rules. Tokens come from the shell env (or ~/.config/claude/.env) via ${VAR} substitution — never inline secrets here.

nextjs._purpose: Live dev-server state: routes, build errors, server logs. Requires the Next.js MCP server flag enabled in next.config.ts and `pnpm dev` running.

supabase-local._purpose: Read-write access to the LOCAL Supabase project for schema work, migrations, and type generation.

supabase-prod._purpose: READ-ONLY access to the production Supabase project. Never enable write tools against this entry.

cloudflare-r2._purpose: Inspect R2 buckets (uploads, processed, public) and presign objects.

cloudflare-observability._purpose: Cloudflare cache analytics, Turnstile challenges, R2 metrics.

vercel._purpose: Deploy status, env-var inspection, function logs, preview URL fetch.

sentry._purpose: Issue search, event details, release tagging.

posthog._purpose: Query events, funnel checks, feature-flag state.

github._purpose: Issue/PR/CI access. Uses GitHub-hosted remote MCP.

shadcn._purpose: Read the local shadcn registry so agents add components by name without re-deriving file shapes.

playwright._purpose: Drive a real browser for E2E debugging and Indic-text snapshot regressions.
